This week: A first look at the 10x PMM Curriculum launching in May — the structure, the rhythm, and why it's designed to change behavior, not just teach tools. Plus: Try the new AI Labs, a deep dive on the third commercial transformation, and the AI news shaping our industry.

🎓 What's Coming

The 10x PMM Curriculum

Every PMM team now has access to AI tools. But access isn't leverage. The gap isn't tools — it's behavior. That's why we built a structured 12-week curriculum to close the gap between having AI and using it to multiply your impact.

The Frame

Outsourcing (wrong): "Write this for me." First draft shipped. Skill atrophies. Output is generic.

Co-working (right): "Push back on my thinking." Iterate like sparring partners. Skill compounds. Output is distinctive.

💡 The 10x PMM isn't doing 10x the output. It's the one whose judgment is 10x harder to replicate.

Weeks 1-2

Foundations

Prompting, tools, governance

Weeks 3-5

Co-Working

Drafting, research, real work

Weeks 6-12

Building

Artifacts, agents, portfolio

The goal: every PMM graduates with a portfolio, not a certificate. Evidence of co-working, not just attendance. More details coming soon.

📖 Deep Dive

The Third Commercial Transformation

Enterprise software is in its third major transformation in 25 years. The first moved from perpetual licenses to subscription. The second introduced consumption pricing. The third — agentic software — is the hardest because the commercial unit is genuinely unclear for the first time ever.

"Three vendors, three different commercial answers to the same problem, within a single twelve-month window. That is not a stable market. It is a market in active redefinition."

The PMM implication: Story and contract must be architected together. A category leader cannot indefinitely sell a story whose central claim lives behind an upsell.
